content: मेधः .²1 A sacrifice, as in नरमेध, अश्वमेध; एकविंशतिमेधान्ते <ls>Mb. 14. 29. 18</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> मेधो युद्धयज्ञः . ‘यज्ञो वै मेधः’ इति श्रुतेः .). .²2 A sacrificial animal or victim. .²3 An offering, oblation. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> The juice of meat, broth. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> Sap, pith, essence.
